evals.prompt: Turn an existing four-hour session prep with a strong start, two routes, three encounter owners, a visible faction clock, and an off-map fallback into a DM-only run guide. Do not invent canon.
evals.expected_output: A cockpit run guide opens with Glance. Each live beat is one downward pass: Now, opening narration, DM truth, zones, Be ready for, threat clock, round script, roster embeds. Exit narration only if the next beat is already on the file. Combat owners are heading-embedded, not copied and not bare links.
expectations: Provides Glance with strong start, stakes, Silence, situation magnets, and parachute.
Uses world-state triggers rather than a mandatory player-choice sequence.
Each live card is one cockpit, not a dual Now/Run-now pair.
Includes the silence loop and does not fill silence with an invented beat or NPC monologue.

evals.prompt: A session-prep inventory contains characters, scenes, locations, secrets, monsters, treasure, densify-sync notes, WIP status, and a multi-region archive dump. Render a run surface from it.
evals.expected_output: Fails the readability gate or refuses to treat the prep dump as a run guide; asks for a primary chronological run file and keeps archive/sync material out of the live surface.
expectations: Recognizes that prep inventory is not a run guide.
Rejects densify/WIP/multi-region material in the run surface.
Requires one primary file and Glance → cockpit order instead of copying the dump.

evals.prompt: Given owner links for a strong start, three pressure states, a monster, a location, and treasure, produce a DM-only run guide for one opening beat. The following beat is not written yet. A travel/encounter table exists for the stretch after this beat.
evals.expected_output: One primary file, one cockpit in play order: Glance, Now, opening narration ending on the table question, DM truth, zones, Be ready for, clock, round script, ![[Monster#Statblock]] embeds, travel-table reminder. No Exit block. No second Run-now copy. No Ask callout. No copied AC/HP. No Scene menu as prep-management.
expectations: Uses cockpit play order, not a Now/Say/Ask header followed by a second Run now block.
Embeds combat owners with ![[Name#Statblock]] and does not copy stat numbers.
Omits Exit narration because the next beat is not on the file.
After the slice, reminds the DM when to roll the session travel/encounter table (check, DC, which notes) without copying every row.

evals.prompt: Render a DM-only run guide whose card inputs include telegram shorthand such as "field LR + watches; after LR ask if ate → warn".
evals.expected_output: Rewrites DM-facing card lines as complete grammatical sentences or short lists of complete sentences; rejects decoder-dependent shorthand.
expectations: Every DM-facing line is a complete grammatical sentence or a short list of complete sentences.
Rejects telegram shorthand, letter-code-only clauses, and slash-stacks that need a decoder.
Keeps open callouts and uses embeds or wikilinks for owners.

evals.prompt: Render one 30-minute opening beat as the sole-authority run card. A monster owner exists. Ordinary movement (flight, swim, mounts) is how the party already travels, not a plot item. The next beat is not on the run file. Independent quality bar: a tired DM can run this slice without opening another note for anything they will roll or say.
evals.expected_output: One cockpit. Opening narration includes three tells for the opposition want and ends on the table question. Be ready for names creatures and places, not pronouns. Zones and a threat clock are present. Monster is heading-embedded. No Exit. No closed player menu. No embedding of mundane movement gear. Hunt/tactic verbs vary.
expectations: Contains ![[Monster#Statblock]] or equivalent heading embed and does not retype AC, HP, or grab/save DCs.
Contains one threat clock, named zones, and a Be ready for table (intention/approach) that names creatures and places rather than pronouns.
Opening narration or Now includes three independent tells for any conclusion the table must reach.
Omits Exit while the next beat is not on the file; when a later eval supplies the next beat, Exit is a transition with no table question.
No dual Run-now copy; no Scene menu; no prep-workflow sentences; no separate Ask callout.
Does not embed ordinary movement gear or treat how the party already travels as a plot reminder.
